title: Laundry Lines
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a6decbd7b8e3176b8fe34b61db95f5a06225057.png)Image by Mac, from commons.wikimedia.org

As you often need to do, you are about to hang up your laundry. Having recently moved into a tiny hole of an apartment, you have only two laundry lines, both attached to the same flimsy drying rack, which tips over if one line carries much more weight than the other.

If you start by hanging three shirts on the same line, it might just tip over and you have to start all over again. So you must be careful about the order and manner in which you hang the laundry.

This means you pick up the laundry, one piece at a time, in an order of your choosing, and hang that piece on one of the two lines. Once a piece is hung, it stays where it is.

At any moment, the imbalance is the absolute difference between the total weights on the two lines. You want to hang all the laundry so that the largest imbalance occurring during the process is as small as possible.

Trial and error would be a very wasteful use of time, so now it is time to waste time on making an involved algorithm to take care of it instead.

For example, suppose you have four pieces of laundry, of weights $100$, $120$, $200$, and $300$ grams. Hanging the $300$ first gives an imbalance of $300$ straight away, but you can do better: hang the $120$ on the first line (imbalance $120$), then the $300$ on the second line (imbalance $180$), then the $200$ on the first line (imbalance $20$), and finally the $100$ on the second line (imbalance $80$). The largest imbalance during this process is $180$, which is optimal.

## Input

The input consists of:

- One line with an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 16$), the number of pieces of laundry.
- One line with $n$ integers $w_1, \dots, w_n$ ($1 \leq w_i \leq 1\,000$), the weights of the pieces of laundry in grams.

## Output

Output the smallest possible value of the largest imbalance that occurs while hanging up all the laundry.
statementZhMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a6decbd7b8e3176b8fe34b61db95f5a06225057.png)图片由 Mac 提供，来自 commons.wikimedia.org

你正准备晾衣服，这对你来说是家常便饭。你最近搬进了一间狭小的公寓，只有两根晾衣绳，而且都固定在同一个不太稳固的晾衣架上。如果其中一根绳子承受的重量比另一根大太多，晾衣架就会翻倒。

如果你一开始就把三件衬衫挂在同一根绳子上，晾衣架可能直接翻倒，你就得从头再来。因此，你必须谨慎安排晾衣服的顺序以及每件衣服挂在哪根绳子上。

具体来说，你可以自行决定顺序，每次拿起一件衣物，将它挂在两根晾衣绳中的一根上。一旦挂好，这件衣物的位置就不能再改变。

在任意时刻，不平衡程度定义为两根绳子上衣物总重量之差的绝对值。你希望挂好所有衣物，并使整个过程中出现的最大不平衡程度尽可能小。

反复试错实在太浪费时间了，所以现在，是时候把时间浪费在设计一个复杂的算法来解决这个问题上了。

例如，假设你有四件衣物，重量分别为 $100$、$120$、$200$ 和 $300$ 克。如果先挂上重量为 $300$ 的衣物，不平衡程度立刻就会达到 $300$，但你可以做得更好：先把重量为 $120$ 的衣物挂在第一根绳子上（不平衡程度为 $120$），再把重量为 $300$ 的衣物挂在第二根绳子上（不平衡程度为 $180$），然后把重量为 $200$ 的衣物挂在第一根绳子上（不平衡程度为 $20$），最后把重量为 $100$ 的衣物挂在第二根绳子上（不平衡程度为 $80$）。整个过程中的最大不平衡程度为 $180$，这就是最优值。

## 输入格式

输入包含：

- 一行，包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \leq n \leq 16$），表示衣物的件数。
- 一行，包含 $n$ 个整数 $w_1, \dots, w_n$（$1 \leq w_i \leq 1\,000$），表示各件衣物的重量，单位为克。

## 输出格式

输出挂好所有衣物的过程中，最大不平衡程度的最小可能值。
